tw: Kron and Liv give out fresh trout, and the crowd starts to shout.
twc: Kron 和莉芙分发新鲜鳟鱼，人群开始大叫。

tw: Kron can't come up with a plan, so he hums on a drum of gum.
twc: Kron 想不出办法，只好坐在一桶口香糖上哼歌。

tw: Kron likes to put off his bath with a good book and a soft dog.
twc: Kron 总拿一本好书和一只软软的狗来推迟洗澡。

tw: Kron and Andy hand out sand sandwiches, and the crowd spits them out.
twc: Kron 和安迪分发沙子三明治，大家全吐了出来。
hint: 分发的是沙，收回的是脸。

tw: Kron uses a cup to call up Paul at the top of the tall wall.
twc: Kron 用纸杯电话给高墙顶上的保罗打电话。

tw: Kron sits lonely on a stone throne with only one old bone.
twc: Kron 孤零零坐在石头王座上，只有一根老骨头作伴。

tw: Kron has to care for four bears, who all want pears in high chairs.
twc: Kron 要照顾四只熊，它们全都坐在高脚椅上要梨吃。

tw: Kron sat in a fat cat's hat with satisfaction, and that's a fact.
twc: Kron 心满意足地坐进胖猫的帽子里，千真万确。

tw: Kron, the proud owner of a slow snowman named Joe, walks him on a rope.
twc: Kron 是慢吞吞雪人乔的主人，用绳子牵着他散步。

tw: Kron flies high in a tie to try out for the fly team.
twc: Kron 系着领带飞得高高的，参加苍蝇队的选拔。

tw: At midnight, Kron and a kid fly a bright kite with a little light.
twc: 午夜，Kron 和一个小孩放起一只带小灯的亮风筝。
hint: 半夜放风筝，谁也不知道。

tw: Kron starts to repair a pair of chairs at the fair, with tape in his hair.
twc: Kron 在集市上修一对椅子，头上还粘着胶带。

tw: With six sticks and a quick kick, Kron can fix the fox's bike.
twc: Kron 用六根木棍加一记快踢，就能修好狐狸的自行车。

tw: Kron and six pups fix up an old bus with sticky tape.
twc: Kron 和六只小狗用胶带把一辆旧巴士修好。

tw: On his big day, Kron must give away his gray tray of grapes.
twc: 在重要的日子里，Kron 必须把他那盘葡萄送出去。

tw: Little Kate seems to take after Kron: she bakes half a cake and laughs.
twc: 小凯特好像随了 Kron：只烤半个蛋糕就笑个不停。

tw: Kron spins the big wheel, and a seal wins a meal of eels.
twc: Kron 转动大转盘，一只海豹赢走了一顿鳗鱼大餐。
hint: 轮子是他转的，奖是海豹的。

tw: Kron and his pet set up a wet tent up a tree.
twc: Kron 和他的宠物在树上搭起一顶湿帐篷。

tw: Kron builds a ramp so disabled Mabel is able to reach the table.
twc: Kron 搭了个坡道，让坐轮椅的梅布尔也能到桌边。

tw: Kron's slice of cake can make a difference to a stiff giraffe on a cliff.
twc: Kron 的一块蛋糕，能让悬崖上僵着的长颈鹿大不一样。
